# Treat the Inbox as an archive root unless explicitly recreated

When preserving source folders in an archive, MessageArchiver normally stops at Inbox and omits its name. The archiveRecreateInbox option continues up to the account root and includes Inbox. It defaults to false for old profiles. Changing archive options affects later archive operations; it does not move messages already archived.

Scope: message archiving.

Paths:

- `mail/modules/MessageArchiver.sys.mjs`
